title: The Real Hot Spring
text: When I return to my room, Yuki-chan—who had come back before me—is there to greet me.
“Welcome home, Motoyasu-sama.”
“I’m back.”
“Spear Hero, how did it go?”
“It’s going smoothly. The hermit doesn’t seem to be showing any signs of trouble either.”
“Indeed. Yuki and Kou are growing up happily, and the Filolial chicks are eagerly awaiting your return.”
The room is filled with the chirping sounds of the Filolial-sama, whom the hermit is tending to. Oh… it’s so soothing.
“I want to go play at Rafu’s place! Is Rafu back yet?”
“He’s back.”
“Really?! I’m going to go play with him!”
Kou adores his Big Sister. So, after seeing Kou off, I ask Yuki-chan.
“How did things go with Ren?”

“I’m not sure what Lord Ren meant. Perhaps he didn’t like my color scheme, but he kept insisting, ‘Do not try to expose the darkness with that light! Darkness is darkness even without light!’ so I didn’t quite understand.”

Oh my… You mustn’t reject someone just based on their Filolial-sama’s color scheme. It’s true that for a while, influenced by my fixation on the Crimson Swine, I was a bit hesitant around red-colored Filolial-samas—like Kuu—but that’s not a good thing. That said, Yuki-chan’s color scheme is the opposite of Black Thunder’s. I suppose that means it doesn’t align with the direction Ren is looking for.

“But he did understand Yuki’s speed. He said, ‘That white flash is worthy of praise. She slices up her enemies in an instant and strikes a pose.’ As for Kou, I watched with a detached gaze as he remarked, ‘It was bad luck for that guy to show up right in front of Kou. He’s going to be Kou’s dinner!’”
Kou and Filo-tan share the same hero archetype. They’re both big eaters, aren’t they? Yuki-chan is striking the pose Renzou taught her.

“He said it would be difficult to spread true darkness without the Jet-Black Claws. The Jet-Black Claws—that must be that shameless black Filolial, right? The slow-footed Filolial that Yuki kicked right out of the way!”

Oh… Black Thunder really is shameless. It seems he attacked Yuki-chan somewhere along the way. But as a man, I can’t say I don’t understand how he feels. Come to think of it, Black Thunder’s vibe does tend to rub off on other Filolial-samas. I’m sure Ren is hoping for a Filolial-sama with Black Thunder’s vibe. He’ll be delighted if I introduce him to plenty of them later.
“Thank you for all the reports.”
“It’s only natural!”

Yuki-chan looks very proud. Anyway, all the information is now in, isn’t it? It seems neither Ren nor Itsuki consider their knowledge of the game to be absolute—that’s a relief. All that’s left is the meeting between the heroes.

And so, the night of the heroes’ meeting has arrived. When I went to the inn’s hot spring, Ren, Itsuki, and the others were in the changing room. It reminds me of the first world. It seems my Father is already in the bath.
“Oh, it’s the Spear Guy!”
Fi… Filo-tan is in the hot spring with my father. Right next to her, my father is frowning and looking this way. Filo-tan got into the bath with my father even sooner than I remembered.
“Father, would you like me to wash your back?”
“I’ve already washed it. Don’t make such a gross suggestion.”
Oh well, I’ve been rejected by my father. ……He really does have a more toned physique than my kind-hearted Father.
“The water temperature looks just right…”
“…Hmph. They say if you don’t rest when you can, you won’t be able to fight when it really counts…”
“That’s right. At the same time, since you never know when that presumptuous darkness will approach, you must never let your guard down.”
Itsuki and Ren—Black Thunder—are following me into the bath. Hmm, I suppose I should wash up before getting in the bath.
“Hmm…”
Eek… For some reason, Filo-tan is coming over to where I’m washing up.
“What’s the matter?”
“Did the Spear Guy want to wash Master’s back?”
“That’s right… Washing my Father’s back might just cleanse my heart as well.”
“Don’t go saying seriously creepy stuff like that!”

Oh? My Father is suddenly protesting for some reason. It’s my sincere feeling, you know. Washing each other’s backs with my Father is such a soothing time. After all, I’ve done it before when I took a bath with my kind Father. Let’s do it again sometime in this loop.
I give my Father a sparkling look. My father’s body is twitching. I wonder if the water’s too hot?

My father is important to me, but having Filo-tan this close right now is making me feel uneasy. So, here’s what I’ll do. I’ll grab my spear… and conjure up some vanilla ice cream to offer to Filo-tan.
“It tastes great when you eat it in a hot bath.”
“What—is this?”
“It’s ice cream.”
“Ice cream! Thanks, Spear Guy!”
After taking the vanilla ice cream from me, Filo-tan goes over to my Father and starts eating it.
“Lately, it seems like I’ve been getting something from Motoyasu whenever something happens…”

My Father muttered that, but for now, I’m focusing on washing myself. Once I’ve finished washing, I step into the tub and soak. Phew… Should I take this opportunity to have a little chat with my Father, Ren, and Itsuki?
“Hmm… You heroes, you’ve all gotten to know your comrades. Isn’t there a female among them you like the most?”
Suddenly, Black Thunder brought up the topic. I remember this. In the first world, I asked, “Who do you think is the most beautiful girl among our comrades?”
“‘Female’—you’re the one saying that…”
Father is glaring at Black Thunder with obvious displeasure. He’s a serious man when it comes to things like this.
“Jaws of Jet Black… Are you really wasting your time on such things…?”
Ren hurls words of contempt at Black Thunder.
“I see… So the Shadow S'yne has no interest in such things?”
“Hmph…”
Ren is smiling defiantly but doesn’t answer. Is that a yes or a no?
“Well, never mind… It’s important to indulge in a little color now and then. Otherwise, you’ll just be swallowed up by the darkness.”
I can understand that he’s saying love is important, too.
“…Ren, you like him, don’t you?”
Father mutters, looking exasperated.
“No, that’s a problem.”
Black Thunder says this in a matter-of-fact tone, a stark contrast to his previous manner. It’s similar to the atmosphere when Crimson Swine drank the Ouroboros Venom.
“I have no need for love…”
Ren is looking up at the sky, but there’s a slight disconnect between him and Father.
“…People are free to fall in love. But since we have a mission, we should keep it in moderation.”
How should I respond here? In the first world, I ended up angering my Father. I asked him if he had any experience, didn’t I? It seems my Father is a virgin.
“Ice cream—sooo good! I wanna eat the ice cream my husband made, too!”
“Save that for later!”
“Father.”
“…What is it?”
“Being a virgin is a pure thing, you know. You mustn’t squander it needlessly.”
“Why do I have to hear that from you of all people in a situation like this?!”
My father got mad at me. But perhaps I should offer a little advice to the Big Sisters here? I feel like the Big Sister in my mind is shaking her head, begging me to stop, but I’ll say it anyway.
“If possible, I recommend you use it sooner rather than later—with a Big Sister or her Big Sister. Otherwise, some evil entity might end up taking your virginity and Father’s virginity.”
“…When you say it, it doesn’t sound like a joke, so seriously, stop it!”
My father is standing up and trying to get out of the hot spring. I’ll grab his hand as he tries to escape and offer some advice.
“Father, I’m sure Big Sister wants you to peek at her in the hot spring.”
“Why on earth would she?”
“You see, when a woman is watched by a man, she feels a sense of modesty, and her charm increases. So peeking in a situation like this is only natural.”
“Don’t force me to peep on her with those murky, ‘beautiful’ eyes of yours. Not over my dead body.”
My Father is quite stubborn, isn’t he? Even in this world, it’s plain as day that Big Sister has feelings for him.

“Well, if you used a weapon made from Soul Eater material, you could probably see through the wall, but that would be rather tacky. For a peeping novice like you, I’ll give you a piggyback ride, or Black Thunder can serve as a stepping stool.”
“This Black Thunder here!?”
“Don’t you want to? There’s a paradise just ahead.”
“Ugh… Fine.”
Black Thunder seems like quite the pervert after all. He didn’t seem interested when it came to Kuro-chan, so that’s a big difference.
“Come on, Father. Paradise is right there.”
“Stop it! I’m absolutely not peeking! If you want to peek, wait until I’m gone—then you guys can do whatever you want!”
Father shook my hand off.
“What kind of logic is that anyway! How on earth did you come up with that idea!”
Just then, Kou comes trotting over from the changing room.
“What are you guys doing?”
“We’re peeking.”
“Peeking? At Raphtalia? Isn’t that bad?”
Kou asks, tilting his little head. Hmm… I suppose being close to his Big Sister has taught him a thing or two.
“Yeah, that’s for sure. If you peek, Raphtalia will get mad at you.”
“Then I won’t, Kou.”
“Kou’s still just a kid, isn’t he?”
“Eh?”
Kou is tilting his head in confusion, but Father just keeps walking toward the changing room.
“Filo, go tell Raphtalia and the others. Tell them to be careful—there are some people trying to peek.”
“Got it! Thanks for the ice, Spear Guy!”
Filo-tan just hopped right over the hedge and ran off. I feel a bit disappointed, yet also somewhat relieved. Ah, I really wanted to gaze at Filo-tan’s naked body from a distance a little longer.
“Hmm!? I’m getting the creeps. What is it? What’s this—?”
I heard Filo-tan’s voice. Ah, my urge to peek is overflowing.
“Well then, let’s all have some fun peeking.”
“…I’ll pass on that.”
“Do as you please.”
Itsuki and Ren were already soaking in the tub. Unlike in the first world, they’re not really into it.
“Well then, Black Thunder, let’s take on Paradise together.”
“Alright! Leave it to me, Drive!”

So, together with the ever-cooperative Black Thunder, I decided to peek over the hedge. When I gently placed my hand on the hedge, electric shocks crackled through it, but I ignored them. It’s probably a trap set by Big Sister’s older sister, but it has no effect on me.

“So it was you, Raphtalia-san. It’s only natural for a fine male to pass on his lineage to the next generation. So if Motoyasu-sama wishes to peek, Yuki will show off her full charm. If you hold back, you’ll miss your chance, you know?”
And so, Yuki-chan and I were discussing how to make her look as alluring as possible in the bathtub.
“No, even if you’re talking about mating in Filolial…”
“Oh my—”
The Big Sister slumped her shoulders in exasperation, while her Big Sister is drinking sake with her hand resting on the hedge.
“Come on, Lord Motoyasu! I want you to fully savor Yuki’s charms!”
Yuki-chan is showing her back… but she’s being a bit too revealing, which actually diminishes the appeal. A sense of modesty is also part of her charm, you know.
“Raphtalia-chan, that Motoyasu-chan is peeking in!”
“Bueeeee!”
Oh? Even Reiska, in her pig form, is here.
“You mustn’t peek! Mr. Motoyasu!”
Oh… I’ve been scolded by Fleon-chan from the sky. However, this Motoyasu isn’t the type to back down just because he got a little scolded—I’m not one to let a little warning stop me from peeking.
“Fleon was giving Mr. Motoyasu and the others a sharp glare just as they were about to peek!　Raphtalia-san, don’t worry! Naofumi-san left the hot spring without even peeking!”
“I-is that so…”
Big Sister says that with a disappointed look. I bet she is, I bet she is. Deep down, she really wants him to see her, too.
“Come on, Big Sister! Work up the courage and let your Father see you!”
“Who do you think you are to say that, Spear Hero!”
Oh? She stopped using the honorific “-sama.”
“Hey, how long am I supposed to keep this scaffolding up?! I’m going to catch a glimpse of this Black Thunder-sama too!”
“We won’t let you! Fleon and Sadeena! Let’s make sure to block him, okay?”
Black Thunder tried to leap up to see Yuki-chan and Fleon-chan, but it didn’t seem to work out. Big Sister used Magic to make it look like the hedge had grown taller.
“Well then, Motoyasu-san, Black Thunder-san, we’re heading up first, so you two do whatever you like.”
“Hmph… how pathetic.”
Just as soon as they finished saying that, Itsuki and Ren walked right out! Weren’t you guys supposed to be the quiet types?
“Raph! I didn’t look—am I good?”
“Uh… not looking is good, but asking about it right here makes it sound like you did look, so please don’t peek under any circumstances.”
“Got it—”
“Oh my, poor Raphtalia-chan. I’m so happy to see how much you’ve grown, Raphtalia-chan.”
“Please don’t see this as a sign of growth. And what do you really think?”
“Maybe I’ll let Naofumi-chan squeeze my boobs a little after my bath—you’d like that too, wouldn’t you, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Sadeena-nee! If you don’t stop joking around, I’m going to get mad!”
“Aww.”

It would’ve been easy to break through, but since it’s important to feel a sense of modesty, I decided to back off here. As a result, only Black Thunder and I ended up getting punished for peeping. That was quite an eventful incident at the lively hot spring. If possible, I’d love for my Father to join us too!
